form.title: Import the folder
form.intro: Choose a folder of the media folder. Every new audio file in it, subfolders included, becomes a library track of this type; files already in the library are left as they are. The files are not moved. The type applies to the whole batch, so keep songs, jingles, and news in separate folders. Playlists are optional: leave them empty and add the tracks to playlists later. The artist is the one you choose here; without one it comes from the file tags, else from the file name: 'Morning - DJ Ann.mp3' becomes the track 'Morning' by 'DJ Ann'. A name with more than one hyphen gives no artist. New artists are added to the artist list.

analyse.intro: Analyse the tracks that have never been analysed. To check other tracks again, for example after changing the broadcast standard in Settings, select them in the library and press Analyse.

waveform.shortcuts: Waveform: Space plays or pauses from the cursor, I sets the start point and O the stop point at the cursor, + and − zoom, 0 fits the whole track. Start or stop point: ← and → move it by 100 ms, with Shift by 1 s, with Alt by 10 ms; Page Up and Page Down by 10 s; Home and End go as far as it can.
